text.A: **Kebijakan ini berlaku di mana pun Anda berada.** Kami mematuhi hukum pelindungan data Britania Raya, dan apabila hukum pelindungan data negara tempat Anda tinggal juga berlaku, kami juga mematuhi hukum tersebut.
text.B: **Catatan alergi dan diet.** Kami meneruskannya kepada food truck bersama pesanan Anda dan tidak menggunakannya untuk keperluan lain apa pun. Kami menghapusnya, beserta nama dan detail kontak Anda, 12 bulan setelah pesanan (lihat bagian 7).
text.C: **Transfer internasional.** Data akun dan data pesanan Anda disimpan dan diproses di Britania Raya (United Kingdom). Beberapa hal ditangani di luar Britania Raya: ekstraksi menu dan balasan otomatis WhatsApp, yang menggunakan layanan Google di Amerika Serikat; pengiriman pesan WhatsApp, yang ditangani oleh Meta di Amerika Serikat; pembayaran, yang ditangani oleh Stripe di Amerika Serikat; dan notifikasi push, yang dikirimkan oleh Apple dan Google di Amerika Serikat. Jika data keluar dari Britania Raya, transfer tersebut dilindungi oleh regulasi kecukupan (adequacy regulations) Britania Raya atau oleh International Data Transfer Agreement (Perjanjian Transfer Data Internasional) atau Addendum, dan, apabila diwajibkan oleh hukum negara Anda, oleh pelindungan yang diakui oleh hukum tersebut. Anda dapat meminta kepada kami rincian pelindungan yang berlaku.
text.G:
[Ketentuan Layanan](/terms) kami berlaku di setiap negara tempat HatchGrab digunakan. Beberapa negara memiliki aturan tambahan. Halaman ini menguraikan aturan tersebut, satu negara demi satu negara.

Apabila suatu bagian di bawah ini berlaku bagi Anda, bagian tersebut merupakan bagian dari Ketentuan Layanan kami. Apabila bagian tersebut menyatakan sesuatu yang berbeda dari Ketentuan Layanan, halaman inilah yang berlaku untuk negara yang bersangkutan.

Apabila negara Anda tidak tercantum, tidak ada aturan tambahan: Ketentuan Layanan berlaku sebagaimana tertulis. [Kebijakan Privasi](/privacy) kami sama di setiap negara.

back.A: **This policy applies wherever you are.** We comply with UK data protection law, and if the data protection law of the country where you live also applies, we also comply with that law.
back.B: **Allergy and diet notes.** We forward them to the food truck together with your order and do not use them for any other purpose. We delete them, together with your name and contact details, 12 months after the order (see section 7).
back.C: If data leaves the UK, the transfer is protected by the UK adequacy regulations or by the International Data Transfer Agreement or Addendum, and, where required by the law of your country, by a safeguard recognised by that law.
back.D: ## 8. Your rights / Under UK data protection law, and the law of the country where you live where applicable, you have the right to: [7 bullets unchanged] / The law where you live may give you these rights under other names, or give additional rights. You also have those rights. / **Making a request.** Send an email to privacy@hatchgrab.com. We will check the authenticity of the request before acting on it. You can ask another person to make the request on your behalf, and we will not treat you differently for making a request. We will respond within one month, or sooner if required by the law of your country. If you ordered from a food truck, we may forward your request to that food truck, because it is that food truck which decides how your order details are used. If we refuse a request, you can ask us to review it again by replying to our answer. / **Deleting your account.** [old text unchanged] If an operator's account is deleted, we also delete its customers' names, contact details and notes from the orders we keep. / **Marketing emails.** We send marketing emails only where permitted by the law where you live, which in some countries means only with your consent. Every such email states its sender, includes our postal address and tells you how to stop receiving them. If you ask us to stop, we will stop, free of charge and within 10 working days. Emails about an order or your account are not marketing. If we or a food truck offer order updates by text message, you will only receive them if you agree, and you can stop them at any time. / **If a problem occurs.** If a breach involving your personal data is likely to cause you serious harm, we will notify you and the supervisory authority as soon as possible where required by law, or help the food truck you ordered from to do so. / **Complaints.** Tell us first at privacy@hatchgrab.com; we would appreciate the chance to put things right. You can also complain to the data protection authority where you live. In the UK, that authority is the Information Commissioner's Office (the UK data protection authority), at ico.org.uk or by telephone on 0303 123 1113.
back.G: Our [Terms of Service](/terms) apply in every country where HatchGrab is used. Some countries have additional rules. This page sets out those rules, one country at a time. / Where a section below applies to you, that section forms part of our Terms of Service. If that section says something different from the Terms of Service, this page is what applies for that country. / If your country is not listed, there are no additional rules: the Terms of Service apply as written. Our [Privacy Policy](/privacy) is the same in every country.
